B.explanation: With length $2L$, $R_Y = (\frac{1}{2}\rho)(2L)/A = \rho L/A = R$, so Y has the same resistance as X.

C.explanation: With length $2L$, $R_Y = (\rho)(2L)/(\frac{1}{2}A) = 4\rho L/A = 4R$, so resistance is four times larger.
